root_cause: The pure verified AI runtime selector checked receipt fields, but the invocation helper accepted a caller-supplied VERIFIED object and therefore did not establish that tenant policy, provider readback, customer consent and CSRD/security approval came from a trusted production authority.
prevention: Reject caller-supplied runtime receipts at the invocation boundary
Require server-owned verified-receipt and cross-domain approval loaders, exact tenant/change/policy versions, active consent, expiry and evidence references
Require the CSRD/ESRS review scope to be cleared with evidence before any non-default runtime adapter executes
Use server-owned pinned endpoint registry; never derive network URLs from a user-configured endpointId
Do not bypass legacy Anthropic sovereignty controls or claim hosted/on-prem adapters are deployed

evidence.outcome: Pure gateway hardening and regression tests only. No production provider adapter or authenticated customer inference activated.
